Commentary.Commentary: Update 1426 local - The covers are off and now the groundsmen are working on the puddles in the outfield. UAE are out on the field, warming up.
Update 1359 local - The covers are being removed and the final word is that UAE won't bat their remaining overs.

Update 1340 local - The rain has eased off again. The groundstaff is out there and getting its work started. Though, it will be a somewhat difficult task to get the water piled up out of there. But positive signs nonetheless.
Update 1314 local - Sorry to deliver the bad news, folks, but IT IS RAINING AGAIN. The delay will continue.
Update 1311 local - The news is that the RAIN HAS STOPPED! Well, that was sudden... but it's good. We hope the game can begin again now quickly.

Update 1248 local - After being put into bat first, UAE were on the back foot as they lost the early wicket of Ashfaq Ahmed. Mustafa, Shabber, Shahzad and Anwar did well in the middle overs to keep the scoreboard going but nobody converted their scores into a big one. Zimbabwe were at one stage found struggling as they were not able to pick up wickets, but they pulled things back very well. Raza was the pick of the bowlers as he managed to get 3 wickets to his name. Naveed's cameo at the very end helped them shift the momentum towards them a little. Rain has interrupted, only time will tell whether the late impetus will mean anything. Hopefully the game can be resumed. We shall keep you updated. Stay tuned...
The drizzle has got heavier and the covers are on the field. It is looking bad at the Harare Sports Club. PLAY HAS BEEN SUSPENDED DUE TO RAIN.
Full length delivery, flicked to square leg for a run.
Dabbed to point for a single.
SIX! Naveed has hit that superbly. The bowler bangs it short, angling in towards the batsman, Naveed pulls it over mid-wicket for a maximum.
Naveed defends a length ball off the front foot.

DROPPED! Raza drops an easy one. One might have thought that he couldn't do any wrong but he does not hold on to an easy one. Naveed tries to heave a length delivery but the ball goes off the upper half of the bat. The ball goes high up in the sky towards mid on where Raza couldn't hold on to it. The batsmen pick up a brace. How costly will it be?
Full and wide outside off, Mufti fails to put any bat to it. 14 runs came off that over.
Dabbed to point for a single.

FOUR! Hat-trick  of boundaries. Short delivery angled towards the batsman, Naveed pulls it over the short fine leg fielder for a boundary. You can't afford to bowl short deliveries when you have fine leg inside the circle.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Length delivery around middle, hit straight behind the bowler's back for a boundary. Naveed has made his intentions clear.
FOUR! Top edge and away. UAE won't mind them. Short delivery outside off stump, the ball takes the top edge of Naveed's bat and runs to the third man fence.
Short delivery outside off stump, guided to third man for a single.
Short delivery outside off, Naveed fails to put any bat to it.
Mohammad Naveed comes to bat.
Back of a length delivery outside off, dabbed to point.

OUT! The short ball has done the trick. The pressure was getting onto him and he had to go for the big shots. Paid the price in the form of his wicket. Short delivery banged in outside off, The batsman pulls it aerially. The ball goes towards the deep square leg region and Mire takes a good catch as he had to take 2-3 steps to his left.
Make it three. The bowler bangs it short towards the batsman. Ahmed tries to pull it away but fails in doing so.
Back of a length outside off, dabbed to point. Two dots.
Back of a length delivery around middle and leg, defended off the back foot.
Blessing Muzarabani comes back into the attack.
Back of a length delivery outside off, played to third man for a single. Just 5 overs to go for the first innings to end.
FOUR! That pierced the gap with perfection. Full and wide outside off stump, Raza drives it with some power between cover and mid off for a boundary.
It is getting darker at Harare. The groundsmen are preparing themselves to bring on the covers.
Slower and full around the middle stump line. Played to mid-wicket for a single.
Length delivery driven down the ground for another run.
Back of a length delivery outside off stump, Ahmed tries to heave it over mid-wicket but fails to put bat to it.
Starts by banging it short towards the batsman. Mufti plays it along the ground to third man for a single.
Kyle Jarvis comes back on. Can he pick up his first wicket in his second spell?
Tossed up delivery around middle and leg, defended off the front foot.
This time towards the shorter side by Sean. Mufti plays it to long on for the 5th single of the over.
Flighted delivery around middle and leg, driven to long on for a single.
Swept to square leg for another run. They are dealing in singles.
Flighted delivery around middle and leg, driven down the ground to long on for a single.
Tossed up delivery which is nudged to square leg for a single.
Full and quick on the legs, played to square leg. Raza ends his spell with 10-0-41-3.
Flatter on middle and leg, played to mid-wicket.
Ahmed Raza walks in to bat.

OUT! Yet another short delivery gets them the wicket. Anwar is the man who has to walk back. He was set and had to play out till the very end but now has to sit in the pavilion and see his mates bat. Raza drags it short and Anwar tries to pull it over the mid-wicket region. He does not get enough height on it and Muzarabani takes a good running catch low to the ground. UAE are six down. They are losing wickets in quick succession.
Quick and short outside off, played to long on for a run.
Short delivery, nudged to square leg for a run.
Quicker delivery, played to long on for a single.
Tossed up delivery worked to square leg for a single.
Flighted delivery, played to mid-wicket.
Floated delivery and it's driven to covers.
Adnan Mufti comes in next.

OUT! Usman finds the fielder perfectly placed at deep mid-wicket. He is unlucky but Zimbabwe are lucky with it. Williams drags it short on the middle stump line, Usman rocks back and pulls it in air towards mid-wicket. Ervine stationed over there takes an easy catch near the rope.
Flighted delivery, defended off the front foot.
Tossed up delivery, driven along the ground to long off for a run.
Sean Williams comes back into the attack.

FOUR! That's just wide of the fielder there! Short and wide, Usman rocks back and cuts it aerially behind square. Muzarabani at short third man moves to his left to take it but it's just wide. It rolls away and goes across the boundary line.
Short ball going on straight, on the stumps, the left-hander meets it with the full face of the bat and blocks it out.
Comes forward and drives the full delivery towards mid off.
Turning on middle and off, Usman plants his front foot forward and blocks.
Yorker darted outside off, it's squeezed in front of point for a quick run.
Flat, quick and on middle and off, Anwar camps back and offers a firm punch to short mid-wicket.
Raza comes back into the attack.
Powerplay 3 has been signalled. 5 fielders are allowed outside the 30-yard circle.

Safe! Cremer doesn't get his man. It looked to be close to the naked eye, but Usman survived. Cremer flights it towards the batsman around the off stump line, Usman got beaten by the air on the delivery. Taylor took the bails off in a flash but replays show Usman was in well within time.
Brendan Taylor looks confident. Thinks he's got his man. Looks close. What will happen? Over to the TV umpire now...
Tossed up delivery driven to long off for a run.
FOUR! Good shot! He sees the ball has got some air so decides to charge down the wicket and hits it through covers for a boundary.
Quicker one on the pads, worked to the square leg region.
Flighted delivery around middle and leg. Anwar sweeps it aerially to square leg for a brace. The fielder does well to save two runs for his side.
Tossed up delivery outside off, driven to covers. Fielder makes a good save.
Back of a length delivery, guided to third man for a single.
Muhammad Usman walks in next.

OUT! Shahzad has to make a long walk back after a well made 59. He fails to convert it into a big one. Just what Zimbabwe would have wanted and not what UAE would have hoped for. He tried to up the scoring rate and paid the price. Back of a length delivery angling in towards him, he tried to loft it over mid off but did not get it off the meat of the bat. The ball lobbed to covers, Cremer over there took an easy catch. Another 74-run partnership comes to an end.
Back of a length delivery, cut to point.
Quick this time. Short delivery outside off, Anwar plays it to third man for a run.
Back of a length delivery played to third man for a single.

FOUR! That was just short of the fielder charging in from long on. Back of a length delivery on the middle stump line. Shahzad stands in his crease and lofts it to the long on region. The fielder misreads it and the ball finds the boundary.
Shahzad comes charging down the track and gets an inside edge as he tries to loft it over mid-wicket. The ball runs to fine leg and they take a single.
Flighted delivery, defended off the front foot.
Tossed up delivery around middle and leg. Anwar comes charging down and drives it along the ground to long on for a single.
Quicker and towards the batsman this time. Anwar nudges it to mid-wicket.
Flighted delivery around off stump, driven down the ground to long off for a run.
Tossed up delivery, punched back to the bowler.
Back of a length delivery which is guided to third man for a single.
Short delivery, defended off the back foot.

4th ODI fifty for Shahzad. Just at the time when his team needed him. He has been composed on the crease and will look to convert it into a big one. Back of a length delivery outside off stump, lofted over point for a brace.
Back of a length delivery, punched to covers.
Back of length delivery, towards the batsman. Shahzad charges down the track to heave it over but fails to put bat to it. It hits him on his body.
Chatara angles it in towards the batsman. He lands it on a back of a length area and it goes through the batsman as he tries to play at it.
Drinks are on the field!
Flighted delivery around off stump, driven down the ground to long off for the third single of the over.
Flighted delivery, defended off the front foot.
Tossed up delivery, defended off the back foot to mid-wicket.
Yet another short delivery around the off stump line, punched to long off for a run.
Short and quick outside off, cut to point.
Tossed up delivery, driven to long off for an easy single.
Short delivery, defended off the back foot.
FOUR! Short delivery down the leg side, Anwar pulls it to the right of the fine leg fielder for a boundary.
Worked to third man for a single.

Well bowled! They cry for yet another appeal, but umpire just like usual, is unmoved. The bowler lands it on a good length angling it towards Shahzad. He leaves it and gets hit high on his pads outside the off stump line. The replays confirm that.
Back of a length delivery outside off, run down to third man for a quick brace.
Length delivery around the middle stump line. The batsman plays it off the front foot. It takes the inside edge and runs to fine leg as the batsmen sneak a single.
Tendai Chatara comes back into the attack.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Driven to long on for a single.
Floated delivery towards the batsman, Anwar defends it off the front foot.
Anwar tries to flick it away but gets hit high on the pads.
Flighted delivery around middle and leg, chipped over mid-wicket for a single. This brings up the 50-run stand. They are going steadily.
Tossed up delivery, driven to long on for a run.
Graeme Cremer comes back into the attack.

SIX! What a shot! Tossed up delivery around off, Shahzad hits an inside out shot over covers and over the fence. The fielder from long off tried to reach there, but failed to make it. 13 runs off this one. UAE on the move!
Quicker and fuller on the stumps, played to square leg.
Shahzad gives himself some room and cuts it past the point fielder. Sweeper cover mops it up but the batsmen pick up two.
Shorter in length by Sean. Anwar punches it to long on for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

FOUR! Nothing much in the delivery. Sean tosses it up towards the batsman, Anwar gets down on one knee and sweeps it fine to the right of the fine leg fielder for a boundary. The fielder was too square and it was difficult for him to stop it.
Back of a length delivery outside off, lofted in air over covers for a brace. 9 runs came off the over. UAE are looking to shift gears.
Length delivery and it's defended off the front foot back to the bowler.
FOUR! Length delivery around the off stump line, Shahzad hits it on the rise over mid on for a boundary. He timed that one nicely.
Wide! Short delivery dragged down the leg side, umpire signals it a wide.
Some dark clouds are seen approaching the Harare Sports Club. Still quite sunny out there, but it was the same in the Windies-Scotland game. Hope nothing of that sort happens today.
Driven along the ground to mid-wicket for a run.
Full delivery angling in towards the batsman, driven to mid on.
Back of a length delivery outside off, worked to third man for a single.
Full ball, on the stumps, eased back down towards mid on for nothing.
Landed short and close to off, a solid defensive shot offered in response.
Turning away from outside off, punched to point. Just the single resulting from it.

FOUR! That's a terrific shot! Been playing the spinners very well today. Makes use of his feet to step out and then whips it with the wrists over mid-wicket, beating the man in the deep for a boundary.
Quicker one attacking the stumps, Shahzad goes inside the crease and brings his bat down in time to block it out.
Tossed up around off from around the wicket, Shahzad kneels across and sweeps it over square leg. It falls safely and two runs are taken.
Short delivery angling in, Anwar tries to work it to the leg side but gets hit high on the pads.
Effort ball! Muzarabani bangs it short in line of the batsman. Anwar defends it off the back foot awkwardly.
Wide! Full delivery dragged down the leg side, the umpire calls it a wide.
Banged short yet again angling towards the batsman. He fails to put bat to it and gets hit near the abdomen area.
Short delivery banged in towards the batsman. Anwar defends it off the back foot.
Back of a length delivery outside off stump, Anwar decides to let it go to the keeper.
Wide! Dragged down the leg side, umpire calls it a wide.
Back of a length delivery outside off, played to third man for a single.
Tossed up delivery, nudged to mid-wicket for a run.
Short delivery, pushed to long on for a run.
Sean drags it short and quick this time, Anwar punches it back to the bowler.
Sean darts it full around middle and leg, Anwar plays it to mid-wicket.
Flighted delivery, full around off. Pushed back to the bowler.
Tossed up delivery, defended off the back foot back to the bowler.
Sean Williams comes into the attack.
Full delivery around the off stump line, driven to mid off. Good over by Muzarabani.

Muzarabani comes wide of the crease and lands it on a back of a length outside off. The ball was angling in towards Shahzad. He tries to flick it but gets hit high on the pads. The hosts cry, but the umpire is unmoved yet again.
Back of a length delivery, Shahzad gets in line and defends it off the front foot.
Length delivery angling in towards the batsman, played to fine leg for a run.
That one kept low. Muzarabani lands it on a back of a length just outside off. Anwar tries to defend it but the ball keeps low and rolls to the keeper.
Short delivery outside off, worked to third man for a single.
Blessing Muzarabani comes back into the attack.
Tossed up delivery, flicked to mid-wicket.
Flatter delivery, full and outside off. Played to third man for a single.
Flighted delivery around leg stump, played to mid-wicket.
Played to the point region.
Driven to long on for a single.
Flighted delivery down the leg side, played to fine leg for a run.
Googly, flicked to mid-wicket.
Tossed up delivery, dragged down the leg side. Anwar sweeps it over the short fine leg fielder for a brace.
Short delivery, cut to the point fielder.
Flighted delivery, Anwar gets in line of the ball and defends it.
Tossed up delivery towards the batsman, defended off the front foot.
Worked to fine leg for a single.
Tossed up delivery, flicked to mid-wicket. A successful over for Zimbabwe.
Driven along the ground to long off for a run.
FOUR! Shahzad comes charging down the track and lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
Tossed up delivery, driven to covers. Good stop by the fielder over there, it was a certain boundary.
Played to fine leg for a single.
Shaiman Anwar comes in next.

OUT! Clean bowled! Raza is pumped! And why wouldn't he be, he's got the big wicket. He bowls it quicker and fuller towards the batsman. Shabber tries to sweep it but fails to put bat to it. The ball goes behind his legs and strikes the timber.
That was a beauty. He bowled it quick and full, turning away from the batsman. He tries to defend it but gets beaten.
Blocked off the back foot.
Defends the wrong 'un off the front foot.
Tossed up delivery, driven to long off for a run.
Some decent air on this as it's spinning in, flicked to square leg.
Floated delivery, Shabber gets forward and defends it off the front foot.
Tossed up delivery, driven to mid-wicket with a closed face for a single.
Punched off the back foot to the bowler.
Shabber gets beaten by the turn on this delivery. Raza tosses it up around off and the ball spins away from the batsman as he tries to defend it off the front foot.
Played to covers for a single.
Flighted delivery towards the batsman, driven to mid on.
Tossed up delivery, driven back to the bowler.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Played off the back foot to point.
Tucked to square leg for a single.
Wide! Tossed up delivery dragged down the leg side. The umpire signals it a wide.
Well bowled! He tosses it up and turns it away from the batsman. Shahzad tries to defend it off the front foot but gets beaten. That wasn't far away from the outside edge.
Driven to long off for a single.
Poor delivery but lucky to get away. He bowls a half tracker which is played to long off for a run. This brings up the 100 for UAE.
Leans ahead to this full ball and knocks it down to long on for a single.
SIX! What a hit! Flighted ball right in the slot, Shahzad clears his front leg and just lofts it cleanly straight over the bowler's head for a maximum.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Over the wicket, it's spinning in from outside off, blocked with the full face of the bat.
Rameez Shahzad walks in next to bat.

OUT! GONE! Mustafa is out of here. One shot too many for the skipper. Sikandar Raza the man to get the breakthrough. Are you even surprised? Does it time and time again. Comes from around the wicket and floats it up on middle and leg, it turns as Mustafa gets low to play the reverse sweep again. He misses once more and is hit on the legs. Loud appeal and this time the finger goes up. Zimbabwe have their wicket, partnership of 74 comes to an end.
Tossed up on the stumps, swept away on the leg side for a couple.
Wide! Down the leg side, wide called by the umpire.
Punched off the back foot to covers.

FOUR! Shabber gets down on his knee and slog sweeps it towards the square leg region. Chatara attacks the ball but the ball lands in front of him and takes a turn towards the fence. It seems he was wrong footed.
Shabber tries to work it to leg side but gets the leading edge towards the backward point region. He fails to pick up the googly.

In the air... but safe. Cremer flights it towards the batsman, Mustafa tries to heave it. He fails to find the meat of the bat and the ball lands in front of the long on fielder. They take a single off it.
Tossed up delivery, driven to long on for an easy single.
Played to mid-wicket for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Reverse swept to sweeper cover for a single.
Well bowled! He got some turn on that one. Gives it some air, towards the batsman, around the fourth stump line. Mustafa tries to defend it off the front foot but gets beaten.
Swept to mid-wicket for a run.
Full delivery towards the batsman, Shabber tries to hit across the line. The ball takes the inside edge onto his pads.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery
Mustafa comes forward and defends it off the front foot towards mid-wicket.
Flighted delivery which is driven to long off for a run.
Punched off the back foot towards the square leg region for a single.
Leading edge rolls towards the backward point region.
Wide! Flighted delivery, spinning down the leg side. The umpire signals it a wide.
Driven to covers off the front foot. It was full and outside off, but with not much turn.
Tossed up delivery, defended off the front foot.
Drinks are on the field.
Raza darts it full towards the legs of the batsman. He tries to defend it but gets struck low on the pads. That was drifting down the leg side.
Floated delivery, defended off the front foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
The batsman looks to sweep a full delivery darted towards his legs. The ball hits his pads and runs to fine leg. They sneak in a leg bye.
Flighted towards the batsman, played to mid-wicket.
Pushed to covers for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery. Good start by Cremer.
Mustafa tries to work it to the leg side but gets struck on the pads. The impact was outside off stump.
Mustafa tries to work it to mid-wicket, but gets a leading edge to covers.
Flicked to mid-wicket.

That was close! But the umpire is not shaken a bit. He flights a full delivery around the off stump line, spinning in towards the batsman. Mustafa tries to reverse sweep but fails to put bat to it. The ball hits low on his thigh pad and Cremer cries for the decision in his favor. The man in the yellow T-shirt is not interested.
Well bowled! He starts by giving it some air outside off stump. The ball turns in towards the batsman. He tries to defend it off the front foot, but gets hit high on the pads.
Graeme Cremer comes into the attack.
Tossed up delivery, defended off the front foot.
SIX! What a shot! Oh boy, what a strike! Raza flights it towards the batsman, Shabber gets on one knee and slog sweeps over mid-wicket for the first maximum of the match.
Punched to covers off the back foot. No run taken.

Sharp turn! The keeper goes for the appeal but the umpire is unmoved. Raza lands it around the leg stump line and gets good amount of spin on this one. Shabber tries to defend it off the front foot but gets beaten.
Driven to long on for a run.
Flighted delivery, defended off the front foot.
Shabber gets in front and defends a length ball off the front foot.
The bowler drags a length delivery outside leg stump. Shabber decided to leave it and the umpire signals it a wide. This brings up the 50-run stand between the duo. Crucial from UAE's point of view.
Leaves the ball moving away from outside off.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Full delivery, angling towards the batsman. Mustafa clips it to square leg for a run.
Short delivery, pulled away to fine leg for a single.

FOUR! Lucky, lucky to get away with that. What is Taylor doing today? That was in no way the catch of the first slip fielder. Taylor had to go for it. Muzarabani lands it on a back of a length spot around the off stump line. Shabber, stuck at the crease, pushes at it. The ball takes the outside edge and flies through the keeper and the first slip fielder to the fence.
Raza fires it full towards the batsman, Mustafa plays it to mid-wicket.
Punched off the back foot to covers for a run.
Floated delivery around the off stump line, defended back to the bowler.
Tossed up delivery towards the batsman, defended off the front foot.
Driven to covers for a single.
Tossed up delivery outside off stump, tapped to point. He got some turn on the first delivery.
Sikandar Raza comes into the attack.
Play and a miss! Shabber tries to slash hard at a wide delivery outside off. He fails to put his bat to it and the keeper collects it with ease.
Short delivery around the off stump line, angling away from the batsman. Shabber defends it off the back foot.
Mustafa fails to put bat to a back of a length delivery angled towards his hips. The ball hits his thigh pad and runs to fine leg. They sneak in a leg bye.

FOUR! Mustafa looks to be in some mood. He watches a length delivery which was angling away from him. Gives himself some room and lofts it over covers for a boundary. He reaches to 22 with this strike.
Length delivery, defended off the front foot.
Wide! The bowler bowls it way wide of the off stump, the batsman decides to leave it. The umpire signals it a wide.
Muzarabani hits the deck hard and lands it on a good length around the off stump line. Mustafa pushes it to covers.
Full delivery, driven back to the bowler.
Jarvis lands it on a good length spot outside off, the batsman lets it be.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Mustafa opens the face of the bat and plays it to point for a run.
Pulled to square leg for a single.
Length delivery outside off stump, left alone by the batsman.

Mustafa, you have to stay there till the very end! Shots like these will take you nowhere. He tries to heave a back of a length delivery over the square leg region. The ball takes the top edge and flies over the gully area for a single.
Powerplay 2 has been signalled. No more than 4 fielders are allowed outside the 30-yard circle.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery. UAE are 50/1. They must be more than happy with this score.
Back of a length delivery outside off stump. Shabber works it past the point fielder for a brace.
Wide! The bowler drags it short and down the leg side. The batsman lets it go and the umpire signals it a wide.

Close LBW shout but the umpire shakes his head. The bowler lands it on a good length spot and Shabber tries to defend it. But fails at it and gets hit on his pads. The replays show that it was pitched outside leg.
Back of a length delivery around the fourth stump line, Shabber shoulders arms to it.
Good length delivery outside off stump, left alone by the batsman.
Length delivery outside off stump, tapped to covers for a single.
Blessing Muzarabani will have a go with the ball. Let's see what he has for us in store.
Length delivery outside off stump, defended off the front foot.
Beaten for the second time in the over. Jarvis bowls it on a good length spot around the off stump line, Shabber tries to defend it but gets beaten by the seam movement.
Jarvis is hitting the good length spot consistently, but he needs to make the batsman play. The batsman lets go a delivery outside off to the keeper.
Full delivery on the legs of the batsman, played to mid-wicket.
Length delivery in the middle stump line, played off the front foot.

Well bowled! Lovely! Pleasing to any fast bowler's eyes. He lands it on a good length spot around the off stump line, seaming away from the batsman. He tries to defend it but gets beaten. That is great stuff!
Back of a length delivery outside off, pushed to point.
Length delivery angling in towards the batsman, defended off the front foot.
Back of a length delivery, nudged to fine leg for a single. Sensible batting by him, takes a single after hitting a boundary.

FOUR! Full delivery outside off stump, driven by Shabber between cover and mid off for a boundary. That was struck well. The fielder at mid off could have done well but fails to save his side some runs.
Well bowled! Chatara got bounce on that delivery. He lands it on a good length around the fourth stump line. Shabber defends it off the front foot.
Good length delivery outside off stump, defended off the front foot.
Effort ball banged in short by Jarvis. Mustafa lets it be. UAE are 41/1. Decent start by them.
Well bowled! Jarvis bangs it short outside off, Mustafa shoulders arms to it.
The skipper has made his intentions clear. He charges down for the second time in his innings. Gives himself some room and lofts a length delivery over the covers for a brace.
Short delivery angling in towards the batsman, Mustafa defends it back to the bowler off the back foot.
Back of a length delivery, towards Mustafa's hips. He tries to work it fine but gets struck on the thigh pad.
Played to mid-wicket for a single.
Flicked through mid-wicket for a brace. 11 runs came off that over. Good start by UAE.
Five wides! That's poor by Taylor. Chatara drags it down the leg side, Mustafa tries to flick it but misses it. Taylor makes a rare mistake in collecting it and the ball runs to the fence.
The batsman picked that bouncer early and let it through to the keeper.
Back of a length delivery around the off stump area, Mustafa lets it go to the keeper without any trouble.
Length delivery outside off stump, Mustafa lets it be.
Effort ball by Chatara. He bangs it short towards Mustafa. He does well to duck in time.
FOUR! Too full and straight, Mustafa won't leave opportunities like these. He works it off his legs, fine towards the right of the keeper for a boundary. Back-to-back boundaries for UAE.

FOUR! Shabber wouldn't mind these. Back of a length delivery outside off stump. The batsman rocks on the back foot and tries to slap it away but finds the outside edge. The ball flies over the second slip region for a boundary.
Jarvis lands it on a good length spot outside off stump. Shabber tries to drive it through covers but gets an inside edge to it. The ball runs to mid-wicket.
Shabber was up to it. He defends a length delivery off the front foot.
Full delivery outside off stump, driven to covers for a single. Mustafa is looking in good touch.
Mustafa shoulders arms to a length delivery outside off.

Good running by the duo. Jarvis bangs it short towards the batsman, Shabber rocks back and pulls it over the square leg region. Till the time the fielder from fine leg could mop it up, the batsmen pick up three runs.
Length delivery outside off stump, left alone by the batsman.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

OUT! A perfect comeback delivery by the bowler. And boy, he looks to be delighted with this one! He lands it on a good length spot outside off, Ahmed tries to push at it and gets the outside edge. The ball is pouched comfortably by Taylor. The hosts' camp looks happy with the early blow.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for the batsman. That was a nothing delivery and had to be put away. Short delivery towards the batsman, Ahmed pulls it over square leg for a boundary.
FOUR! Up and over! This time it's Ahmed who registers a boundary. This was in his hitting zone. Length delivery outside off stump, the batsman lofts it over mid off for his first boundary.
Good length delivery, defended off the front foot.
Length delivery outside off, Mustafa shoulders arms to it.
Good thinking by the bowler. He varies his pace on this one and bowls it full towards the batsman. Mustafa defends it off the front foot.
Good cricket! Well bowled and well left by the skipper! Jarvis lands it on a good length spot around the fourth stump line, Mustafa does well to leave that it.
Jarvis drags a back of a length delivery towards the batsman's body, Ahmed tries to pull it but fails to do so. The ball rolls towards the keeper and till then they sneak in a leg bye.
Length delivery, seaming in towards the batsman. Ahmed defends it from the crease off the front foot.
FOUR! Beautifully played by the skipper. Chatara bowls a length delivery way outside off stump. Mustafa comes charging from his crease and whacks it over covers for the first boundary of the match.
Short of a length delivery, outside off stump. Ahmed taps it to third man for a single.
Ahmed taps a length ball to mid-wicket. Good start by Chatara.

Full length delivery outside off stump, Mustafa runs it to third man for a single.

Play and a miss. Good delivery to end the over with. Jarvis lands it on a good length spot outside off stump, seaming away from the batsman. Ahmed tries to put bat to it but gets beaten.

Leading edge but safe. Short delivery banged towards the batsman, Ahmed plays it off the back foot. He gets a leading edge which falls way too ahead of the bowler.

Good delivery first up. Lands it on a good length spot around off stump, seaming away from the batsman. Mustafa opens the face of the bat and guides it to third man for a single. UAE get their first run on the board on the very first ball.
The umpires are out in the middle. Rohan Mustafa and Ashfaq Ahmed will open the innings for UAE. Kyle Jarvis will have the new ball in hand. Let's get started...
The players are out in the middle to pay respect to their respective national anthems.
Pitch report - There is decent amount of grass on the wicket. There are cracks too which will help the faster bowlers early in the innings.

United Arab Emirates playing XI - Rohan Mustafa(C), Ashfaq Ahmed, Ghulam Shabber(WK), Rameez Shahzad, Shaiman Anwar, Muhammad Usman, Adnan Mufti, Ahmed Raza, Mohammad Naveed, Amir Hayat, Qadeer Ahmed.
